text.tspan: Verification Panel — mandatory gate. The user must review every extracted value before normalization.
If gates fail or Ollama is down — Tier 3 (cloud) is tried
only when admin-authorized, otherwise fall back to the Tier-1 result.
Phase 2 — at this layout-acceptance point, geometry relationships
(room adjacency, room connections, fixture placement) are written to the
Apache AGE graph inside the same PostgreSQL, and are later queried

svg.text: insert file row (name, SHA-256 checksum, size)
run parser for the file type (sheet / CAD drawing / image)
request catalogue-match suggestions for fixture labels
suggestions shown inline in the panel
Tier 2 — labels-only payload built by payload_builder (no coordinates sent)
layout_guard gates vs the Tier-1 baseline
snap walls + render SVG plan (SVG = Scalable Vector Graphics)
export layered DXF file via ezdxf
